items: Fixed the 5 CodeQL alerts (path injection) in `skills_lib.py`. The recipe buttons of the Skills page (send, export, approve from the inbox, list) took the skill name from the request through a text check. They now look the name up among the skills that exist on disk, like every other console endpoint, so the request can never steer a file path. A skill that does not exist has an empty recipe list instead of an error.

The tests of the Fab Checklist no longer depend on the kit installed in your profile. One test failed on GitHub (where no profile exists) and turned the release red; it now uses the kit files of the checkout.
release.title: v1.110.1 — Security: recipe endpoints
